title: French Revolution
summary: Old-regime France collapsed in a decade of upheaval that abolished the monarchy, redrew society, and sent shockwaves across Europe.

stories.title: Fall of the Monarchy
stories.summary: From the Bastille to the guillotine — how France overthrew its king.

events.title: Storming of the Bastille
events.body: Parisians stormed the royal fortress-prison, seizing arms and killing its governor. The event became the symbolic birth of the Revolution.

events.title: Women's March on Versailles
events.body: Thousands of market women marched from Paris to Versailles demanding bread. They forced the royal family to return to the capital under popular pressure.

events.title: Flight to Varennes
events.body: Louis XVI and his family fled Paris in disguise, hoping to reach royalist forces. They were recognised and arrested at Varennes, destroying trust in the king.

events.title: Execution of the King
events.body: The Convention tried Louis XVI for treason and sent him to the guillotine. Europe's great powers recoiled at regicide and prepared for war.

events.title: The Terror
events.body: The Committee of Public Safety ruled by emergency decree. Tens of thousands died on the guillotine or in mass executions as revolution consumed its own.

stories.title: Rise of Napoleon
stories.summary: From artillery captain to First Consul.
